summary: Regional Management Corp. filed an 8-K to report two routine amendments to existing credit facilities. The First Amendment modified a senior revolving credit facility to incorporate definitions related to receivables pledged from a bank partner. Separately, Amendment No. 8 to the RMR IV warehouse facility amended definitions, added subsidiaries as originators, and extended the revolving period and maturity date by one year each. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situations event was announced. The filing reflects ordinary-course financing arrangements without structural changes, premium, or shareholder action. No deal terms or strategic catalysts were provided.
